mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS today_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN operation_status IN ('WAITING', 'COOKING', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'DELIVERING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN operation_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN operation_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS canceled_order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= #{startAt} AND ordered_at < #{endAt}
